facts.fact: 弟弟 Symon 次日要参加自己的实操考试，晚饭时段缠着姐姐 Moyna 在他在二年级宿舍的房间里当他的练习搭档，两人尽量用 Camarran 语对话
facts.anchor: Symon had his own practical exam the next day

facts.fact: Moyna 让 Symon 在自己右手第三指背侧的整齐深切口上练习止血，Symon 用魔法止住了流血
facts.anchor: freely seeping blood from the neat, deep cut across the back of the third finger

facts.fact: Grand Exam 第一例是 hare fever，Moyna 只是闭口不言、没有说出答案，全靠 Jehan 想出答案，否则他们那组很可能失败
facts.anchor: If Jehan hadn’t figured it out, then they’d have likely failed the case

facts.fact: 五例中只能失败一例，失败两例就必须重读一年；Moyna 盘算从内部破坏一次治疗、把失败归咎于紧张或失手
facts.anchor: Once your group failed two, you had to repeat the year

facts.fact: 当天早上 Moyna 曾想从屋顶跳下自尽，但没能鼓起勇气
facts.anchor: She hadn’t gathered the guts to fling herself off a rooftop this morning

facts.fact: Moyna 法定欠她的学院赞助人 Greteford 市议会五年服务，而她父母打算余生都留在 Camar
facts.anchor: Legally she owed its city council, her Academie sponsors, five years

facts.fact: Moyna 在淋浴间向 Charlon Paul 求欢，Percy Surreau 与 Amelie Viart 撞见，Percy 喊着 Seriously 扔海绵砸在 Charlon 背上
facts.anchor: Percy Surreau yelped, “Seriously,” and threw a sponge which bounced off Charlon’s back

facts.fact: Moyna 想到 Ysabel 的尸体时，觉得 Clement 的确信很有说服力，但仍记得 Brodier 的话：门门考前十的耀眼人物也可能藏着深重的痛苦
facts.anchor: Clement was convinced, and their certainty was convincing
